demo.title: cortx.sh
demo.code:
# Check before paying — is this endpoint reliable?
cortx status serviceId="a1b2c3d4"

# Full breakdown before an agent calls an x402 API
cortx reliability serviceId="a1b2c3d4"

# Check for active incidents on a monitored endpoint
cortx incident serviceId="a1b2c3d4"

setup: No API key required — public reliability data is open
Service IDs are published by endpoint owners via their CORTX badge or status page
To set up monitoring for your own x402 endpoint: usecortx.dev
